title: Howden PRO D-Series 30'-36' | Cooling Tower Fans
description: The Howden D-Series cooling tower fans are highly efficient cooling fans which combines the highest aerodynamic performance with very low power consumption.

layout.title: Howden PRO D-Series 30'-36' | Cooling Tower Fans

bullets.text: Delivers high efficiency and reduces power consumption
Boosts cooling performance designed to deliver the optimum aerodynamic performance
Damps mechanical vibration: the FRP blades offer vibration damping and good chemical resistance.
Durability and longevity the fan blade is integrated (rather than bolted on) to the shaft, reducing mechanical stress at the joints
Simple to assemble – D-series fans come with clear technical documentation
Applications – Field-erected cooling towers, air-cooled condensers (ACC)
